no_adcom_quote.quote: There were no controversial clinical issues identified by the review team that would have benefitted from an advisory committee discussion.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the original approval of PERJETA (pertuzumab, BLA125409). The Office/Division Director memo for Orig1s000 states under its 'Advisory Committee Meeting' section that no controversial clinical issues were identified that would have benefitted from an advisory committee discussion. The approval proceeded on the basis of the pivotal PFS result with an embryo-fetal toxicity boxed warning, without an AdComm.
